brief: 20 distinct SOULI reaction comedies, not 20 variants of the homepage banner. Each episode uses a different renderer SVG, location, dominant palette and visual gag. The audience should laugh first and wonder what SOULI is second.
format: 8-second landscape masters; visual punchline without sound, spoken dialogue or burned-in text. Keep the action centrally crop-safe.
brand_constants: Original SOULI stepped pixel silhouette is the art reference; preserve face pixels in future production. Current cinematic drafts have the per-episode variations documented below.
One clear emotion and one visual reversal per clip
Tactile dimensional characters in believable physical scenes
No lavender-and-coral village duo reused for this pack
creative_rules: 0–1s: an immediately understandable absurd setup; 1–4s: escalation; 4–6s: one payoff; 6–8s: hold the reaction.
Humor mechanisms rotate: scale mismatch, anticipation, reversal, literal interpretation, anticlimax and deadpan reaction.
Vary material and cinematography with the scene while preserving the source character identity.
The caption adds a second joke; the picture must still work with no caption.
No price predictions, fake partnerships, fabricated milestones or claims of actual gameplay.
A market caption requires a fresh ETH context check. Do not use market comedy in place of incident communication.
No forced loop if it weakens the punchline. Never count a still image as a finished video.
Do not publish or schedule; preparation only. Retain masters and captions for later selection.
release_proposal: After publishing resumes: 4 original posts per week total, initially 2 comedy clips, 1 real development clip, and 1 community/Base or product post. At 2 comedy clips per week, this is up to 10 weeks of draft inventory before editorial selection. Never release all 20 at once.
selection_metrics: Compare voluntary shares, relevant replies, profile visits and clip reuse where visible. Likes are one signal, not proof of buyer demand. No promises of virality.

episodes.hook: 커피 추출구 바로 밑에 선 손바닥만 한 소울
episodes.payoff: 커피 한 방울을 맞자 전동칫솔처럼 과충전되고, 끝에는 멀쩡한 척 멈춘다
episodes.caption: gm. system overheating.
episodes.video_prompt: 8-second single-shot miniature physical comedy. Keep the orange stepped SOULI and espresso-machine setting from the reference. At 0–2s one giant coffee drop stretches from the spout. At 2–3s it gently plops onto the top of the toy with a realistic little splash; this is harmless slapstick, not injury. At 3–6s the orange soul suddenly vibrates rapidly in place like an over-caffeinated toy, rattling a few nearby droplets; its whole rigid body moves without growing limbs. At 6–8s it freezes perfectly still and looks deadpan at the camera with one foam bubble on its head. Keep the face recognizable and the camera locked. No text, speech, logos, extra characters or cuts.
episodes.observed_result: 커피 방울 뒤에 진동하고 거품 장식으로 멈춘다.
episodes.editor_note: 커피 과충전은 읽힌다. 얼굴과 팔다리가 원본보다 만화적으로 변한다.

episodes.hook: 땀밴드까지 차고 필사적으로 뛰는 소울
episodes.payoff: 카메라가 살짝 넓어지면 처음부터 제자리였고, 멈추자 뒤로 천천히 밀려난다
episodes.caption: all that effort. still sideways.
episodes.video_prompt: 8-second one-shot funny gym miniature. The icy-blue SOULI on the treadmill makes fast earnest tiny whole-body running bounces for 0–4s, staying exactly in place while the belt visibly moves. Its sweatband jiggles. At 4–6s it proudly stops, and the still-moving belt gently carries the rigid toy backwards a short distance. At 6–8s it gives the camera a deadpan look. No fall, no damage, no human legs or arms; preserve the stepped silhouette and pixel eyes. Very slight smooth camera widening reveals the stationary treadmill. Real belt friction and shadows. No writing, numbers, logos, dialogue or cuts.
episodes.observed_result: 필사적으로 뛰지만 제자리인 러닝머신 장면.
episodes.editor_note: 횡보 캡션과 맞는다. 팔·다리와 새 표정이 추가되며 후반 뒤로 밀리는 반전은 약하다.

episodes.hook: 숲까지 와서 휴대전화에 얼굴을 붙인 소울
episodes.payoff: 풀잎이 휴대전화를 덮어버리자 처음으로 주위를 본다
episodes.caption: touch grass. grass said enough.
episodes.video_prompt: 8-second forest miniature comedy. Keep the green smiling SOULI, realistic moss and tripod phone. At 0–3s the soul leans closer to the phone, ignoring the beautiful forest. At 3–5s one long blade of grass gently bends over the phone screen like a curtain, fully covering it, with no human hand shape. At 5–8s the soul pauses, then slowly turns its whole rigid body toward the camera and takes in the forest. The smile remains recognizable; humor comes from timing, not facial distortion. Soft breeze, real moss textures, locked camera. No text, logos, chart details, new characters or dialogue.
episodes.observed_result: 풀잎이 휴대전화를 쓰러뜨리고 소울은 웃는 채 남는다.
episodes.editor_note: v2에서 얼굴과 실루엣이 유지되고 풀의 개입이 명확해졌다.

episodes.hook: 문 앞에 서 있는 무심한 큰 귀 소울
episodes.payoff: 아주 짧은 레드카펫을 직접 펼치고 거만하게 한 걸음, 곧바로 카펫 끝
episodes.caption: eth green for 5 minutes. me:
episodes.scene: The terracotta and mint-faced tall-eared SOULI from the reference, rendered in glazed ceramic, waits at the door of a plain warm beige apartment hallway. A tiny rolled red carpet rests at its feet, comically short. Low fashion-photography angle, realistic terrazzo, one small wall lamp, no crowd. Initial setup before the carpet unrolls.
episodes.video_prompt: The tiny red carpet unrolls only one body length. The SOULI confidently glides forward like a celebrity, immediately runs out of carpet and stops awkwardly on the plain hallway floor. Hold a long deadpan beat. One shot, realistic carpet physics, no human limbs, no text or other characters.
episodes.observed_result: 짧게 펼쳐진 레드카펫을 금방 벗어나 멈춘다.
episodes.editor_note: 반전은 읽힌다. 걷는 동작에 팔다리와 새 표정이 생긴다.

episodes.hook: 휴대전화를 뒤집어놓고 간식을 찾는 작은 소울
episodes.payoff: 냉장고 문을 열자 야채들이 상승 캔들 높이로 서 있다
episodes.caption: taking a break from the charts.
episodes.scene: Small grey SOULI with pale-pink facial patch as a soft felt voxel toy in a midnight kitchen. It stands by a closed miniature fridge door already slightly ajar, a facedown blank phone on the counter. Moody pale white fridge light at the gap, burgundy shadows, domestic realism, character in profile but eyes visible.
episodes.video_prompt: The fridge door slowly opens. Inside, upright cucumber and carrot sticks are arranged in absurd ascending staircase heights like a generic candlestick chart, no graph labels. The SOULI freezes, turns its rigid body toward the camera in disbelief, then quietly shuts the fridge. One continuous shot; no extra limbs or text.
episodes.observed_result: 냉장고 속 상승 계단 모양 야채를 본 뒤 문을 닫는다.
episodes.editor_note: 야채 차트 농담은 캡션과 함께 읽힌다. 첫 화면에서 야채가 일부 보이고 얼굴이 변한다.

episodes.hook: 토스터 옆에서 졸고 있는 소울
episodes.payoff: 토스트가 튀자 놀란 소울도 동시에 점프하고, 빵보다 늦게 내려온다
episodes.caption: gm to everyone except my alarm.
episodes.scene: A sleepy yellow SOULI with pale cyan accent rendered as a soft sponge voxel figure beside a retro cream toaster on a butter-yellow breakfast table. Two slices just visible in the toaster slots. Natural late-morning sunlight, crisp toast crumbs, joyful editorial still life. Initial frame before toast pops.
episodes.video_prompt: Hold one sleepy second. Two slices of toast suddenly pop normally. The SOULI startles and makes one exaggerated straight vertical jump higher than the toast, hangs in the air for a ridiculous half-second, then lands gently after the toast has settled. Hold its embarrassed stillness. No injury, limbs, text or dialogue.
episodes.observed_result: 토스트와 함께 놀라 점프하고 뒤늦게 내려온다.
episodes.editor_note: 점프 타이밍이 명확하다. 표정은 원본의 영화적 변형이다.

episodes.look: 흰 솜 토이·분홍 아이스크림과 쨍한 청록
episodes.hook: 선베드 위에서 아주 침착한 표정
episodes.payoff: 옆의 아이스크림만 초고속으로 녹고 소울은 천천히 카메라를 본다
episodes.caption: doing absolutely fine, fren.
episodes.scene: White round stepped SOULI with pink face patch and dark original pixel marks, rendered as fluffy short-pile flocking, sits on a tiny striped poolside lounger. An absurdly tall pink ice cream cone stands in a holder beside it. Bright turquoise pool reflections, midday heat shimmer, luxury holiday macro shot. No human people.
episodes.video_prompt: The SOULI stays almost perfectly still while the tall pink ice cream slowly leans and then slumps into a comically large puddle beside the lounger. A single drop lands near the soul; it slowly turns to camera with its unchanged deadpan face. No melting of the character, no injury, no text.
episodes.observed_result: 길쭉한 아이스크림이 무너지는 동안 소울은 옆에서 지켜본다.
episodes.editor_note: 과장된 녹음이 읽힌다. 일부 얼굴 변형이 있다.

episodes.hook: 주변은 맑은데 머리 위에 작은 구름 하나
episodes.payoff: 옆으로 피할 때마다 구름도 정확히 따라오고 결국 포기
episodes.caption: market weather is personal today.
episodes.scene: Golden-yellow SOULI with squinting dark pixel face and pink accents, as a satin clay voxel sculpture on a sunlit beach boardwalk. Everything is cheerful pale coral and seafoam. One tiny charcoal raincloud floats immediately above only this character, at least a head-height gap. Initial frame with just one drop falling, no umbrella.
episodes.video_prompt: A tiny cloud drizzles only on the SOULI. The soul makes one cautious sideways scoot; the cloud follows exactly. It scoots the other way; the cloud follows again. It pauses and faces the camera, resigned, while the sunny background remains dry. Gentle harmless water, no deformation, no text.
episodes.observed_result: 좌우로 피하는 금빛 소울 위로 작은 먹구름이 따라온다.
episodes.editor_note: v2에서 긴 토끼 귀로 바뀌던 문제가 개선되어 원래 금빛 실루엣과 얼굴이 유지된다.

episodes.hook: 거대한 카트 앞에 작지만 자신만만한 소울
episodes.payoff: 카메라가 카트 안을 보여주면 완두콩 단 한 알
episodes.caption: portfolio up. groceries upgraded.
episodes.scene: Tiny charcoal stepped SOULI with its cream facial pixels, rendered in matte rubber, proudly beside a full-size shiny metal grocery cart in a realistic supermarket aisle. Low wheel-height camera, cool fluorescent light, colorful but unreadable packages. One single green pea in the otherwise empty cart can be just barely glimpsed through the mesh.
episodes.video_prompt: The tiny soul confidently pushes the giant cart a very short distance using its whole body. Camera gently cranes up to reveal only one solitary green pea rolling around in the enormous empty cart, then holds as the soul proudly bobs once. Real wheel motion, no text, no human limbs.
episodes.observed_result: 카메라가 올라가며 커다란 카트 안 완두콩 한 알을 보여준다.
episodes.editor_note: v2에서 소울이 별도 머리·몸을 가진 사람 형태로 변하던 문제를 해결했다. 동작은 카메라 중심이다.

episodes.hook: 회의실 의자에 축 늘어진 소울
episodes.payoff: 문이 열리자 번개처럼 퇴장, 의자만 계속 회전
episodes.caption: when someone says we can end early.
episodes.scene: Periwinkle SOULI with tall curled stepped head and original two black pixel eyes, rendered as a smooth-edged but block-shaped silicone toy slumped on an oversized black swivel office chair in a lavender meeting room. Closed glass door, blank wall and a glass of water. Dry symmetrical office comedy composition.
episodes.video_prompt: The meeting-room door begins opening. After one frozen anticipation beat, the small soul swiftly slides off the chair and scoots out through the doorway. The empty chair spins slowly for the remaining two seconds while the camera stays fixed. No human coworkers, text, explosion or limbs.
episodes.observed_result: 소울이 회의실을 나가고 빈 의자만 돈다.
episodes.editor_note: 퇴장 농담이 읽힌다. 움직일 때 얼굴이 달라진다.

episodes.hook: 몸보다 큰 나초를 살사에 찍으려는 소울
episodes.payoff: 소스가 너무 끈적해 나초 대신 소울이 그릇 쪽으로 끌려간다
episodes.caption: just one more dip.
episodes.scene: Warm brown SOULI with horizontal lavender-pink pixel markings rendered as baked terracotta voxel figure, beside a bowl of thick red salsa and one huge triangular tortilla chip leaning against its front. Rustic orange table, warm restaurant bokeh, real crunchy chip texture. No reference to money or buying.
episodes.video_prompt: The soul leans the tortilla chip into the thick salsa, then tries to pull it back. The chip remains stuck and the toy slides comically toward the bowl instead. It stops safely at the rim, pauses and slowly turns toward camera. One simple physical gag, no consumption, injury, limbs or text.
episodes.observed_result: 나초가 살사에 기울고 소울이 곁에서 함께 기울어진다.
episodes.editor_note: v2에서 원래 픽셀 얼굴은 유지된다. 소스에 끌려가는 계획된 핵심 반전은 충분히 구현되지 않았다.

episodes.look: 빨간 금속 토이·녹색 LED와 산업 조명
episodes.hook: 거대한 서버 앞에서 탁상 선풍기를 들이대는 소울
episodes.payoff: 바람은 서버 대신 자기 머리의 종이 장식만 펄럭인다
episodes.caption: doing my part, fren.
episodes.scene: Dark red spiky stepped SOULI with its central black facial patch and peach pixels, rendered as anodized metal toy on a data-center floor. A very tiny desktop fan sits between it and enormous server racks. Green indicator dots without text. A little unbranded paper ribbon rests on the character's head. Dramatic industrial depth, no fire or emergency lights.
episodes.video_prompt: The little fan switches on and whirs earnestly. Its airflow only flutters the SOULI's tiny paper ribbon; the huge server room remains entirely unchanged. The soul confidently gives one proud rigid-body nod to camera. No emergency, outage, damage, text, logos or human limbs.
episodes.observed_result: 작은 선풍기는 서버 대신 소울 머리의 종이만 날려버린다.
episodes.editor_note: v2에서 원래 얼굴 유지와 종이 낙하 반전이 모두 읽힌다.

episodes.look: 작은 노랑 비닐·검은 우주와 새하얀 실내
episodes.hook: 지구를 보는 엄숙한 작은 소울
episodes.payoff: 뒤에서 떠온 감자칩 한 장 때문에 장엄한 포즈가 무너진다
episodes.caption: big plans. easily distracted.
episodes.scene: Tiny bright yellow SOULI with red and charcoal eye pixels, as a vinyl voxel toy inside a clean white spacecraft observation cupola. Enormous Earth beyond curved glass, crisp black space. A single potato chip floats far behind the soul. Majestic cinematic wide composition with the toy clearly readable, no helmets hiding the face, no logos.
episodes.video_prompt: The soul floats solemnly looking at Earth. A single potato chip drifts slowly across its face. It immediately abandons the majestic view and pivots its whole body to follow the chip, clumsily rotating once in zero gravity. Hold the absurd small pursuit against Earth. No collisions, text or limbs.
episodes.observed_result: 우주를 바라보다 떠다니는 감자칩을 따라 회전한다.
episodes.editor_note: 관심이 작은 과자로 옮겨가는 반전이 읽힌다. 표정은 일부 변한다.

episodes.hook: 문 앞에 바짝 붙어 기다리는 두 눈 소울
episodes.payoff: 문이 열리는데 너무 성급해 제자리에서 잔발만 구르다가 늦게 탄다
episodes.caption: me waiting for literally anything.
episodes.scene: Small terracotta SOULI with two raised dark pixel eyes, rendered as stitched leather-texture voxel toy, waits almost touching closed art-deco brass elevator doors. Black-and-cream marble floor, warm hotel sconces, symmetric low shot. No floor numbers or signs.
episodes.video_prompt: The impatient soul jitters rapidly in place while the elevator doors open very slowly. Once open, it freezes and keeps waiting for one absurd second, then suddenly scoots inside just as the doors begin to close, safely before they do. End on the empty hallway. No injury, limbs, text or jump cuts.
episodes.observed_result: 엘리베이터 앞에서 조급하게 떨다가 뒤늦게 들어간다.
episodes.editor_note: 캐릭터가 비교적 유지된다. 기다림에 관한 일상 반응용이다.

episodes.hook: 근엄하게 포즈 잡는 긴 꼬리 소울
episodes.payoff: 바람이 불자 멋진 스카프가 얼굴에 달라붙는다
episodes.caption: new pfp. nailed it.
episodes.scene: Peach SOULI with tall curled flame-like silhouette and pale cyan mask with dark pixel eyes, rendered in velvet-flocked voxel sculpture in a fashion photo studio. A lightweight sky-blue scarf drapes beside its face. Seamless pink backdrop, softbox catchlights and a visible small wind machine far to the side. Pose is excessively serious.
episodes.video_prompt: The soul poses proudly as the fan starts. The scarf first billows beautifully then flips directly across its pixel eyes and sticks there. The toy holds its supposedly glamorous pose for a long awkward beat. Physical silk movement, no deformation or human limbs, no text.
episodes.observed_result: 스카프가 날아와 눈 위 이마에 감긴다.
episodes.editor_note: 얼굴·모양은 유지되지만 스카프가 눈을 완전히 가리는 반전은 구현되지 않았다.

episodes.hook: 일할 준비를 하고 쿠션에 살짝 기대는 소울
episodes.payoff: 쿠션이 너무 푹신해 천천히 완전히 파묻히고 눈만 남는다
episodes.caption: five minute break, fren.
episodes.scene: Large peach rounded stepped SOULI with grey eyebrow-like pixel markings and dark original eyes, rendered as soft plush voxel sculpture, perched on an enormous oatmeal knitted sofa cushion in a cozy amber living room. A closed plain laptop on side table. Comically small figure to giant cushion scale, evening lamp light.
episodes.video_prompt: The soul gently leans back for a short rest. The cushion slowly gives way and swallows the toy deeper and deeper until only the top of its head and pixel eyes peek out. It remains comfortable and unharmed. Hold the two eyes staring from the cushion. No text, logos, new limbs or melting.
episodes.observed_result: 쿠션에 기대었다가 천천히 파묻혀 눈과 머리만 남는다.
episodes.editor_note: 캐릭터 유지와 쿠션에 잠기는 반전이 잘 읽힌다.

episodes.look: 초록 고무 토이·푸른 하늘과 원색 파티 소품
episodes.hook: 작은 몸에 비해 거대한 환영 풍선 한 개
episodes.payoff: 풍선이 소울을 발끝만 뜰 만큼 들어올리고 태연한 척한다
episodes.caption: new frens got me floating.
episodes.scene: Tiny green SOULI with two charcoal pixel eyes and light mint highlights, rendered as rubber voxel toy on a sunny city rooftop garden. One gigantic plain cobalt balloon is tied around its middle with a loose gift ribbon; no brand mark. Bright sky, warm bricks, a few paper party cups, joyful realistic sunlight.
episodes.video_prompt: A gentle breeze lifts the enormous balloon, raising the SOULI only a small distance above the rooftop. The soul tries to remain dignified while slowly turning in the air, then drifts gently back down. One awkward celebratory bob, clearly safe and playful. No writing, endorsement logos, humans or extra limbs.
episodes.observed_result: 거대한 풍선에 작은 소울이 들렸다가 돌아온다.
episodes.editor_note: 환영용으로 적합하다. 강한 웃음보다 귀여움에 가깝고 표정이 변한다.

episodes.hook: 폭풍을 버티는 듯 진지한 소울의 클로즈업
episodes.payoff: 카메라가 넓어지면 작은 욕조에서 고무오리 지나가는 파도였다
episodes.caption: survived another wild session.
episodes.scene: Indigo U-shaped SOULI with pale yellow and peach pixel accents rendered as a bath-safe rubber voxel figure perched in a tiny paper boat among white foam. Start at water level with tight heroic composition. Teal bathroom tiles softly out of focus, one small yellow rubber duck far behind, realistic small ripples, no real storm.
episodes.video_prompt: The paper boat rocks dramatically on tiny ripples while the SOULI holds a heroic stiff pose. Camera gently pulls back to reveal the entire scene is a peaceful bathtub and a small rubber duck caused the ripples. The duck glides past; the toy stares at camera. No sinking, danger, text or limbs.
episodes.observed_result: 욕조 속 작은 배가 흔들리고 고무오리가 지나간다.
episodes.editor_note: 영웅적인 태도와 소소한 파도의 대비. 첫 화면부터 욕실이 보여 장소 공개 반전은 약하다.

episodes.look: 토프색 나무 토이·어두운 버건디와 스폿 조명
episodes.hook: 고급 요리 평가하듯 접시를 내려다보는 소울
episodes.payoff: 거대한 은색 뚜껑을 열면 감자튀김 한 가닥
episodes.caption: a very serious investor dinner.
episodes.scene: Taupe tall-eared SOULI with original purple eye stripe and small dark mouth, rendered as carved painted wood voxel sculpture seated at a fine-dining table. Enormous polished silver cloche covers a plate before it. Burgundy velvet background, dramatic warm spotlight, miniature place setting with no text or logos.
episodes.video_prompt: The silver cloche rises slowly by itself with theatrical steam, revealing one solitary French fry on an enormous pristine white plate.
